name: uk.co.cybercentry/b20-verification
title: Cybercentry B20 Token Verification
description: Check a Base B20 token can actually be sold: honeypots, frozen exits, issuer controls. $1 USDC.

tools.name: verify_b20_token
tools.description: Start a Cybercentry B20 token verification: can this token actually be sold? Checks pool-hook honeypots, whitelisted exits, freeze-and-seize, live pauses, fakes and issuer controls. Returns a jobId — poll it with get_verification_report. Costs $1 USDC, so a payment reference is required.

address.description: The token contract address to verify, as 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

txHash.description: Proof the scan was paid for. Supply ONE of `txHash` (a Base transaction hash for a $1 USDC transfer to the treasury) or `paymentId` (a Base Pay payment id). Each is single-use. Without one the call returns 'Payment required'.

paymentId.description: Proof the scan was paid for. Supply ONE of `txHash` (a Base transaction hash for a $1 USDC transfer to the treasury) or `paymentId` (a Base Pay payment id). Each is single-use. Without one the call returns 'Payment required'.

freeSig.description: Your one free verification. Call get_free_scan_challenge first, sign the message it returns, then pass { wallet, message, signature } here. One per wallet, ever. Omit this and the call is paid: in-band over x402, or with txHash / paymentId.

tools.name: get_free_scan_challenge
tools.description: Free. Your FIRST verification costs nothing — call this to get the exact message to sign, then pass the signature to verify_b20_token as `freeSig`. The message is a SIWE message bound to this app, your wallet and the chain, and it expires in 5 minutes, so sign and spend it promptly. One free verification per wallet, ever.

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign, as 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

tools.name: get_verification_report
tools.description: Fetch the report for a jobId returned by verify_b20_token. Free to call. While the scan is still running this returns status 'running' with a retryAfter in seconds — wait that long before calling again.

tools.name: verify_quote_asset
tools.description: Settle any token address against the issuer's published tokenized-stock list and read what it is a claim on — a quote asset, a basket, an ERC-4626 wrapper. Synchronous, no polling. Costs $1 USDC, so a payment reference is required.
